node.title: Re^7: Blessing with unknown classnames
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I guess this is some kind of "class autovivification" you are doing?

Like I said, Perl's object system is very simple: ->isa('Error') (inherited from [doc://UNIVERSAL]) is just looking up the inheritance tree, and the inheritance tree is defined by each package's [doc://@ISA], which is just an array of strings, so that's all I needed to define to make the "classes" "exist". [doc://perlmod] is a good read on this topic.
